definitions.gloss: vegetable dish; vegetable cooking; vegetable cuisine
definitions.explanation: A dish or style of cooking that features vegetables as the main ingredient. Can refer to a single dish or to vegetable-based cooking in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's make a vegetable dish today.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has a rich selection of vegetable dishes and is popular with health-conscious people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: With vegetable dishes using seasonal vegetables, it's important to bring out the natural flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables) + ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, dish). Commonly used on menus, in cookbooks, and in everyday conversation about food. In traditional Japanese cuisine, vegetable dishes play a central role alongside fish and rice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a vegetable dish
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野菜料理|やさいりょうり}: seasonal vegetable dish
- {野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧: vegetable dish recipe
- {野菜料理|やさいりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: to be good at making vegetable dishes

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese {野菜料理|やさいりょうり} often emphasizes seasonal ingredients (⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧), simple preparation that highlights natural flavors, and visual presentation. Buddhist temple cuisine (⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧) is an entirely vegetable-based tradition.
